description: Fastrack Revoltt XR1 Pro is a unisex smartwatch with a stylish plastic case, 1.43-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, 100+ multisport modes and health monitoring for heart rate, SpO2, sleep and stress. It supports Android 12.0 and above and iOS 16.0 and above. The 280 mAh lithium-polymer battery provides upto 5 days of battery life and charges in up to 2 hours.
